answers.description: Garden design, planting plans and ongoing maintenance for homes in Harrogate and Knaresborough. We also build paths, patios and raised beds.

brand.name: Hawthorn Gardens
brand.tagline: Garden design, planting plans and ongoing maintenance for your home.

hero.headline: Thoughtful gardens for Harrogate and Knaresborough
hero.subhead: Garden design, planting plans and ongoing maintenance for homes in Harrogate and Knaresborough.
hero.reassurance: Tell us about your garden, no pressure, just a chat.

features.title: Design, planting and maintenance, done with care
features.lead: We plan, plant and look after gardens around your home and how you want to use it.

items.title: Garden Design
items.body: We plan gardens around your home, your space and how you want to use it, from first sketch onward.

items.title: Planting Plans
items.body: We choose and arrange planting that suits your garden, so it grows well and looks right through the seasons.

items.title: Paths and Patios
items.body: We build paths, patios and raised beds, adding structure and practical spaces to your garden.

steps.title: How we work with you
steps.lead: From first conversation to finished garden, here's what happens along the way.

items.title: Get In Touch
items.body: Tell us about your garden and what you'd like to change, and we'll arrange a time to talk it through.

items.title: Design and Plan
items.body: We visit, discuss ideas and put together a design and planting plan suited to your space.

items.title: Build and Maintain
items.body: We carry out the work, from paths and planting to raised beds, then keep your garden looked after.

copy.statement: We care about gardens that work for the people who use them, in Harrogate and Knaresborough.

cta.headline: Ready to talk about your garden?
cta.body: Get in touch and tell us about your garden and what you'd like to change.
cta.reassurance: We'll arrange a time to talk it through, no obligation.
